context.head: HEAD
context.missing: Worktree is missing or has drifted

sessionSwitch.message: Git is still showing the original checkout.

targetSwitch.title: Switch Git checkout?
targetSwitch.body: The current checkout has a selection or commit draft. It will remain with the original checkout and will not move to the new target.

branchAdoption.notice: AgentPort saved {{expectedBranch}}, but this Worktree is currently on {{actualBranch}}.
branchAdoption.title: Accept current branch?
branchAdoption.body: Update AgentPort's saved branch from {{expectedBranch}} to {{actualBranch}}. This does not switch branches or modify working files.
branchAdoption.activeSessions: {{count}} active Sessions use this Worktree; their working directory will not change.
branchAdoption.succeeded: Current branch accepted; Git Center writes are enabled

states.empty: This checkout has no uncommitted changes.
states.stale: The repository changed. Git state is being refreshed and writes are paused.
states.partial: The result is incomplete ({{reason}}). Stage and commit are disabled.
states.missing: The Worktree is missing or no longer belongs to this Project.
states.conflicts: {{count}} conflicts remain. Resolve them, then explicitly mark them resolved and stage.

selection.selectAll: Select every file in this group

fileActions.discardBody: Restore the unstaged contents of {{path}} from the index. AgentPort cannot undo this action.
fileActions.trashBody: {{path}} will be moved to the macOS Trash and can be restored from there.

remote.protectedBranch: Force Push is disabled for main/master

blocked.busy: Another Git operation is in progress
blocked.branchRequired: A committed local branch is required
blocked.noUpstream: The current branch has no upstream

confirm.noIncoming: The last refresh found no incoming commits; Pull will still Fetch the latest state.
confirm.sessionWarning: {{count}} active Session(s) use this Checkout; Pull changes the files they see.

pull_rebase.title: Pull and rebase the current branch?
pull_rebase.body: Fetch from {{upstream}} and rebase the local {{branch}} commits onto it.

force_push.title: Safe Force Push the current branch?
force_push.body: Rewrite {{upstream}} using --force-with-lease. Git rejects the operation if the remote has changed.

dirty.title: Auto-stash local changes, then {{action}}?
dirty.body: Git temporarily auto-stashes tracked local changes and restores the staged and unstaged state after updating. Untracked files stay in place; Git refuses the operation if the remote would overwrite them.

entry.ignoredNoPreview: Ignored files show names only and cannot be previewed or staged.

diff.title: Diff preview
diff.empty: Select a file to preview its diff.
diff.large: This diff exceeds the safe display limit. Only a truncated result or statistics are shown.

history.newCommits: New commits found. Existing pagination remains anchored to the original HEAD.
history.select: Select a commit to view its details.

commit.title: Commit
commit.scopeNote: Commit includes every currently staged change in this checkout. Files are never staged automatically.
commit.noStaged: There are no staged changes to commit.
commit.detachedBlocked: Ordinary Commit is disabled on detached HEAD.
commit.operationBlocked: Ordinary Commit is disabled while {{operation}} is in progress.
commit.conflictsBlocked: Resolve and stage every conflict before Commit.
commit.reviewWarning: Confirming runs one git commit. If HEAD, index, scope, or message changes, the backend rejects the write and requires a new review.
commit.outsideProject: These staged paths are outside the Project directory:
commit.subjectOver72: The subject exceeds 72 characters. This is a warning only.
commit.activeSessionWarning: An active Session uses this checkout. Committing may affect its next operation.
commit.confirm: Confirm and commit every staged change
commit.draftPreserved: Your draft was preserved. Review again before retrying.
commit.aiReplaceBody: The generated subject and body will replace this draft. Generation does not modify the index.
commit.aiDraftPreserved: The current draft was not changed. Check the service under Settings → AI Provider and try again.
commit.aiStale: Staged changes changed during generation. The result was discarded; refresh and try again.
commit.aiTruncated: The staged diff was large, so AI used a size-limited excerpt. Review the message carefully.

outcomes.not_executed: The commit did not run. Check the error and review again.
outcomes.scope_drift: A commit was created, but a hook changed the confirmed scope. Inspect it immediately.
outcomes.indeterminate: The commit result is uncertain. Inspect the real HEAD and do not retry automatically.
